_comment: Cloudflare R2 CORS configuration for the direct browser upload (presigned PUT). Apply to the PRODUCTION bucket dictafan-prod. Production origin is https://dictafan.com. No wildcard (*) is used. NOTE: the browser sends Content-Type on the presigned PUT, so it MUST be in allowed_headers, and PUT MUST be in allowed_methods — otherwise the preflight (OPTIONS) is denied and fetch() fails with 'Failed to fetch'.
